audit_scope: All monetary arithmetic in the arbitrage execution path

types.name: TokenAmount
types.purpose: Raw token quantity tagged with mint and decimals. Prevents cross-mint arithmetic.

types.name: ProfitAmount
types.purpose: Signed profit/loss in a specific mint. Checked add/sub enforce same-mint.

types.name: TokenPrice
types.purpose: Price quote with slot provenance for staleness checks.

types.name: DimensionalError
types.purpose: Explicit error type for all dimensional accounting violations.

functions: lamports_to_base_raw_checked() — converts lamports to base raw with staleness check
base_raw_to_lamports_checked() — converts base raw to lamports with checked arithmetic

rules_enforced: Never add or subtract raw amounts from different mints (DimensionalError::MintMismatch)
Never compare raw USDC units with raw WSOL lamports (DimensionalError::MintMismatch)
Never calculate ROI using amounts with different denominations
Never convert token amounts using implicit decimals — explicit scale only
Never use unverified default conversion price — rate must be provided
Reject missing, stale, or inconsistent price conversion data (DimensionalError::StalePrice)
Use checked arithmetic and explicit rounding policies (ceiling division)
Reject overflow, underflow, and invalid decimal metadata
Final profit must be denominated in the original borrowed/input mint
For cyclic routes: input_mint == final_output_mint, otherwise reject

existing_type_review.arb_types::TokenAmount: pub struct TokenAmount(pub u64) — simple u64 wrapper, NO mint/decimals metadata. Cross-mint mixing possible at type level.
existing_type_review.arb_types::Lamports: pub struct Lamports(pub u64) — SOL-specific. Used incorrectly for base-mint raw units (the root cause).
existing_type_review.arb_types::ExecutionOpportunity: Has base_decimals but NO base_mint field — denomination must be inferred from hops[0].mint_in.
existing_type_review.arb_types::SizedOpportunity: Has both base_mint and base_decimals — correct design pattern.

recommendations: Migrate arb_types::TokenAmount to include mint + decimals (like dimensional::TokenAmount)
Replace all Lamports() casts of non-lamport values with explicit denomination types
Make dimensional::TokenAmount the canonical amount type across the codebase
